template_name: WWT AUS QBR Native Slides Template - TEST tokenized

data_sources.performance: GA4 API generated performance.csv on API Source Test.
data_sources.trends: DataForSEO Google Trends YTD current and previous-year CSVs on API Source Test using Australia location.
data_sources.auction_insights: Manual Google Ads and Microsoft Ads Auction Insights CSV uploads for the same QBR period.
data_sources.other_campaigns: Optional manual Google/MS campaign exports; GA4 campaign data is used as fallback.

generation_rules.original_deck_rule: The source presentation is never edited. The app copies this template deck and edits the copy.
generation_rules.period_rule: The overall deck remains quarter-led. Trend slides show current YTD against prior-year YTD.
generation_rules.destination_rule: AUS destination sections use China, Japan, SE Asia, India, and Other.
generation_rules.destination_mix_rule: Destination campaign mix tables include inline YoY for cost, leads, cost share, lead share, and CPL.
generation_rules.chart_rule: Charts are rendered locally as high-resolution PNGs and inserted into existing native image slots. Cost vs Sales Leads charts are grouped bars for both metrics.
generation_rules.style_rule: Generated decks explicitly restyle cover, divider, closing, header, and footer text white so black template bands remain readable after text replacement.
generation_rules.currency_rule: AUS report values and chart labels use AUD currency formatting.
generation_rules.auction_rule: If either manual Auction Insights CSV is missing, keep the auction slide with review-required content.
